final: WITH ranked_standings AS (SELECT cs.raceId, cs.constructorId, cs.wins, r.year, r.round, cir.country, LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round) as prev_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitId = cir.circuitId), country_avgs AS (SELECT country, AVG(COALESCE(wins - prev_wins, wins)) as avg_wins_gained FROM ranked_standings GROUP BY country), all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) as mean_val FROM country_avgs), above_first AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins_gained FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN all_mean am WHERE ca.avg_wins_gained > am.mean_val), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) as second_mean FROM above_first), final_countries AS (SELECT af.country, af.avg_wins_gained FROM above_first af CROSS JOIN group_mean gm WHERE af.avg_wins_gained > gm.second_mean) SELECT AVG(f.avg_wins_gained) as mean_final_avg, AVG(f.avg_wins_gained - (SELECT mean_val FROM (SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) as mean_val FROM country_avgs))) as mean_excess_all, AVG(f.avg_wins_gained - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) FROM above_first)) as mean_excess_group FROM final_countries f, (SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) as mean_val FROM country_avgs) all_m
